answer:
The attribute is `Settings.callback_manager`. The settings guide shows you assign a `CallbackManager` to it, which makes the handlers it holds available globally:

"Settings.callback_manager = CallbackManager([token_counter])" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/supporting_modules/settings.md]

The same guide says the `Settings` object "is a simple singleton object that lives throughout your application" and that "Whenever a particular component is not provided, the `Settings` object is used to provide it as a global default" [llama_index/docs/src/content/docs/framework/module_guides/supporting_modules/settings.md]. That is why a handler attached there applies across the application.
